extracted.intended_audience: faculty, principal investigators, research staff, and business managers at University of Illinois Chicago conducting or supporting research
extracted.subtask_description: A university administrative guidance page listing required and commonly used trainings, applicable research policies, and the electronic systems used to prepare, submit, route, and manage grants and compliance disclosures at UIC. It orients researchers and staff to compliance steps and tools they must use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete required training before conducting research
rubrics_metrics.description: Training is often required before certain types of research can take place. Links to the most commonly used training are provided and questions about access should be directed to ovcrweb@uic.edu.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Researchers must complete applicable trainings prior to engaging in the associated research activities; contact ovcrweb@uic.edu for assistance accessing training.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human Subjects Training
rubrics_metrics.description: Human Subjects Training (listed as a primary required training).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the linked human subjects training program (e.g., CITI) to meet IRB and federal requirements for work with human participants.

rubrics_metrics.name: CITI Training
rubrics_metrics.description: CITI Training (Collaborative Institutional Training Initiative) is listed as a training resource.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete relevant CITI modules required for your role (PI, research staff, etc.) as evidence of human subjects protections training.

rubrics_metrics.name: Animal Care and Use Training
rubrics_metrics.description: Animal Care and Use Training is listed as a commonly required training.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete institutionally required animal care and use training prior to working with vertebrate animals or engaging in activities overseen by the IACUC.

rubrics_metrics.name: Environmental Health and Safety Training
rubrics_metrics.description: Environmental Health and Safety Training is listed among required trainings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete relevant EHS modules to ensure safe handling of materials and compliance with lab/safety policies before performing the associated activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Learning Management System
rubrics_metrics.description: Learning Management System is listed as a place to access trainings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use UIC's LMS to access, complete, and track required institutional trainings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Banner
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Banner is an institutional system referenced on the page; follow local institutional guidance for its use where required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Policy: Human Subjects Research
rubrics_metrics.description: Human Subjects Research is listed under policies relevant to conducting research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adhere to the University policy on human subjects research (IRB requirements, protections, training, and submission procedures).

rubrics_metrics.name: Policy: Animal Care and Use
rubrics_metrics.description: Animal Care and Use is listed as an institutional policy area.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comply with the University's animal care and use policy, including training, protocol approval, and IACUC oversight.

rubrics_metrics.name: Policy: Institutional Biosafety
rubrics_metrics.description: Institutional Biosafety is listed among the policies to follow for certain research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow institutional biosafety policies for handling biohazardous materials, including training and protocol approvals as required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Policy: Export Controls
rubrics_metrics.description: Export Controls are listed as a relevant policy area.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure compliance with export control requirements for technologies, data, collaborations, and travel as specified by university policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Policy: Conflict of Interest
rubrics_metrics.description: Conflict of Interest is listed as a policy researchers must follow.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclose and manage personal and financial conflicts per the University Policy on Conflict of Commitment and Interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Policy: Responsible Conduct of Research
rubrics_metrics.description: Responsible Conduct of Research is listed as a policy area.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete required RCR training and adhere to standards for research integrity and responsible practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Policy: Electronic Systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Electronic Systems is listed as a policy/resource category relevant to research administration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use designated electronic systems for submissions, disclosures, and grant management as required by university procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: START (Systemwide Tools for Administration of Research and Training)
rubrics_metrics.description: START is the grants management software leveraging open source (Kuali Coeus) and University-developed software to modernize and streamline research enterprise processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use START as part of the University's grants management infrastructure to reduce administrative burden and to meet financial, legal, and ethical obligations related to grants.

rubrics_metrics.name: myResearch Portal
rubrics_metrics.description: myResearch integrates and displays information from a number of different university systems, giving faculty access to the information they need to prepare, submit, route, and manage their grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PIs and Business Managers can use the myResearch Portal to prepare, submit, route, and manage grant proposals and awards; consult portal updates for changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: OSPWeb
rubrics_metrics.description: OSPWeb is the web-based system used to deliver documents to OSP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use OSPWeb to submit documents electronically to the Office of Sponsored Programs — it eliminates the need for hard copies and sends confirmation and assignment emails for review.

rubrics_metrics.name: UIC Research – COI (Conflict of Interest disclosures)
rubrics_metrics.description: UIC Research – COI is the online application to perform processes for compliance with the University Policy on Conflict of Commitment and Interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete and submit COI disclosures through the UIC Research – COI system to meet institutional disclosure and management requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: UIC Research – IRB (IRB submissions)
rubrics_metrics.description: UIC Research – IRB is a web-based IRB submission system that allows PIs and their staff to create and submit online IRB applications including electronic routing for signatures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare and submit IRB applications via the UIC Research – IRB system and use the electronic routing feature for required signatures and approvals.
